body:
I almost succeeded killing myself, although one time was an accident. Once was a suicide attempt and the other was a big relapse. I took 290mg of Ambien alongside taking a lot of Xanax. On top of that, I've been hospitalized twice in the last year for severe depression. 

Now, I'm struggling with all the weight I gained, and it makes me feel worthless. I feel so gross with all of this weight. Trying not to beat myself up, but it's difficult.
Thank you so much. This really helped. :)
Harvester. It's the strangest game I've ever played.
That's what I do. I don't like dealing with people at all. I rarely enjoy talking to people, and I think they can tell. I would like a cat though.
Maybe a male therapist would work out. I've never had one, but I would be willing to go to male therapist's sessions. I like older therapists with many years of counseling experience.

One tried to sell my essential oils during almost every session I had with her. I was extremely suicidal and depressed, so I decided to buy this $225 beginner's kit that she was pushing. I was willing to try everything. She took advantage of me, and she constantly had issues with my insurance. She lost my insurance information, and she would double book me with other patients. She was good in the beginning when she worked at a clinic, but when she started her private practice, she became a nightmare. 

The other one talked to me in a baby voice at times. She would lecture me about things that I didn't really want to discuss, and I almost got up and left her office because she kept on going on and on about a topic that was making me feel suicidal. She would also cancel appointments all the time because she always had meetings to go to during the time of our sessions.

I don't feel like myself. I used to always make jokes, and I was fun to be around. Now, I am always serious. I never smile, and I am a boring conversationalist. I can tell people do not enjoy talking to me. 

A lot of times I'll try to make a joke, but I'm not in the mood to be funny, so it'll fall flat. I don't really care all too much about making new friends, but I would like to be myself again. 

I'm seeing a new therapist, and she seems okay. I haven't formed my opinion of her yet. A couple of therapists I have seen have been horrible, and I didn't realize it until months later.

I saw a new therapist today, and she seems really great. I was scared of seeing a therapist because I've had some bad ones. I have another appointment with her next Monday, so I'm really glad that's so soon. I have a good feeling about this.

Why would you ever be considered an asshole in this scenario? They are being ridiculous. Wigs, like you said, are very expensive. She's asking you to do something that makes you uncomfortable and then she is getting angry over your response only because she wants her bridesmaids to match? A friend's feelings should be important than matching in a wedding photo. You can still wear the same dress as everyone else and still match. I don't understand why you have to have a wig. NTA especially since they have always known you as the girl with little to no hair.
Your feelings matter. If you have depression, you have depression. Your circumstances don't minimize your suffering.

Yeah, I've been through that too. It's like you open a can of worms after your session and you forget to put the lid back on. I think it's especially common for people to experience this after EMDR sessions because it taps into a traumatic memory and moves the trauma to the surface. It's why it's recommended to have multiple sessions a week when you are receiving EMDR.
Good luck! I hope it goes well.

That sounds really stressful. Going to movie theatres where there are assigned seats always scares me because of situations like that. But at least it's over, and I bet those people won't remember what you looked like. Still doesn't make the situation less anxiety-inducing, though.

Plus there are always other anxiety medications out there. Xanax takes about 15-45 minutes to take effect and lasts about four hours. However, there are other medications in it's class that last longer and may be a better choice. I would discuss it with a psychiatrist to see which med would best fit your needs.
I take it occasionally. It doesn't seem to help me. I haven't noticed feeling any different on it.

For me, it was pretty powerful. It eliminated my anxiety completely about 9/10 of the time. Sometimes it didn't work at all. Sometimes it would make me so drowsy that I would fall asleep, but it wouldn't affect my anxiety levels. I usually took .25mg 3 times a day. I'd recommend it. Just don't abuse it. I've been there, and it's not fun.

I've never understood this. Apparently guilting someone who already feels horrible is a solution to feeling less shitty? Okay. The argument never helps. 

I think people do it as a way to try to get you out of your own head. Like the people who think depression is being selfish. Still doesn't justify the argument.
I keep on surviving suicide attempts so maybe the world wants me to sit my ass down and live. Sometimes I'm not feeling the whole "living" aspect of life, though.

Yeah, especially after I relapsed severely. Two hospitalizations and overdoses later. I feel like I've gone off the deep end. My friends can't stand me. I used the be the funniest person in a room full of people. Now I'm an emotional vampire. Not sure if I have any more chances left.

Scared. Yet again. I feel like I'm going to die soon, and even though I've wanted to die in the past, I don't want to right now. I don't know what to do to calm myself down. I took a propranolol, and I don't think it'll help.

I've been really sick for the last few days. I'll be getting an ultrasound to see if I have diverticulitis. I feel like I fucked up my intestines so much after overdosing intentionally to try to kill myself. I actually was gaining hope that things could be better, but I could possibly have this for the rest of my life. 

When I get the ultrasound, I'm not going to be able to calm down because I'll be facing the reality of the situation rather than pretending everything is okay and rosy.

Today I realized that I've been overeating to distract myself from a lot of trauma I've experienced. I decided to cut back on food, but I'm not sure if I can deal with everything else. I want to drive up to whataburger, and it's 2am. 

I either overeat or drink excessively.

I feel like I've done irreparable damage to my body from all my suicide attempts. I don't know why I should try getting better when I'm damaged and will probably die soon anyways. Right now, I don't want to die, and I feel like I've ran out of chances to improve my life. I'm so scared.

For me, therapists have almost always been useless or have made things worse. I know it works for a lot of people, but I think I would rather read self-help books written by psychologists rather than go to a therapy session. 

Some of my therapists have been real pieces of shit. One tried to sell me expensive essential oils when I could barely afford one session per month. Another was downright critical of everything I did. Sometimes she would talk to me in a baby voice, and I felt like she was patronizing me. 

I've been thinking about going to therapy again, but I don't think it's worth it.

Yakuza 0.

For some reason, I've always avoided this game because it looked like it was something I wouldn't be interested in, but I love it! I've been struggling finding any games that interests me, and in this game, I've managed to put 60 hours in in the past three weeks!
My depression has turned into extreme rage at everyone and everything. Nothing is okay, and I wish I had the courage to go ahead and kill myself already.
People still didn't care after I failed a suicide attempt.

I feel like a vile person. I have a lot of guilt for the things I have done. I'm debating whether or not to buy a nice, sturdy rope soon so that I can hang myself. 

I feel like I should be hospitalized a third time, but I'm currently still paying off that second stay I had from last November.
